changes.after:
Crafted from smooth neoprene fabric, these brown loose-fit trousers provide a cushioned feel and a lightweight warmth. They feature an elasticated drawstring waistband, vertical front pin-tuck seams, angled side pockets, and straight hems. Throw them on with a loose white T-shirt, a matching navy bomber jacket, and white leather sneakers for a smart, coordinated look. 

Care Instructions:
● Hand wash up to 30°C/86°F
● Do not wring or twist
● Air dry in the shade; do not tumble dry
● Do not bleach
● Do not iron
